text: FAA guidance instructs reestablishing the control link and, if that fails, initiating emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link, with preflight briefings including control link loss procedures and actions if VLOS cannot be maintained. DJI Matrice 4T manual states the aircraft will automatically initiate RTH when signal loss occurs (if set to RTH), may show the RTH path via vision, will use Advanced RTH per settings, and will continue RTH even if the remote signal is restored, or brake and hover then enter Original Route RTH when vision is unsuitable. Incident reports exist as unverified accounts of lost-link events involving the Matrice 4T.
